access.notes: Open-source Python library for CALPHAD calculations; can be installed via pip.
Contains the Gibbs energy functions for Fe, Al, and P as a function of temperature. Distributed with pycalphad or OpenCalphad, or obtainable from SGTE.

Data from published journal articles: Cox and Pool (1967) for heat capacity; Peviak and Sandulova (1974) and Itagaki and Yamaguchi (1990) for heat capacity; Wang et al. (1963), Kischio (1965), Martosudirdjo and Pratt (1974) for enthalpy of formation; melting point from Kischio (1965); liquidus from Panish et al. (1969), Beer (1969), Lescuyer et al. (1998); vapor pressures from Maria et al. (1968). All are publicly accessible via libraries/databases.
Binary Fe-P description from You & Jung (2020). The TDB file or published parameters are expected to be available as supplementary material or from open CALPHAD databases.
Binary Fe-Al description from Phan et al. (2014). The TDB file or published parameters are expected to be available from open CALPHAD databases or the journal supplementary.
